concepts.canonical_he: כלי וצנור לקבל על ידו החסד
concepts.gloss_en: A vessel and channel through which to receive the divine chesed (gradually)

members.form: כלי וצנור לקבל על ידו החסד
כלי וצנור לקבל על ידו השפעת החסד
members.note: same phrase; object head is השפעת החסד ('influx of chesed') vs plain החסד — minor construct expansion of the same received item, same referent in this passage

concepts.canonical_he: חקיקה וצנור לקבל על ידו החסד
concepts.gloss_en: An engraving/carving and channel to receive the chesed — distinct head noun (חקיקה 'engraving') vs כלי 'vessel'

members.form: חקיקה וצנור לקבל על ידו החסד

notes: All three occur in lm2:4 describing making a receptacle/channel to receive chesed by degrees. חקיקה ('engraving/carving') is a different head noun from כלי ('vessel') (rule 4: different construct/head = different concept), so kept separate despite the shared 'וצנור לקבל על ידו החסד' tail — they may be author-equated images in context, but under-merge is preferred.
